text: The sons of Levi (joined to): Gershon (exile), Kohath (assembly), and Merari (bitter).
The sons of Kohath (assembly): Amram (exalted people), Izhar (shining oil), Hebron (association), and Uzziel (my strength is God).

The children of Amram (exalted people): Aaron (light bringer), Moses (drawn out), and Miriam (rebellion). The sons of Aaron: Nadab (generous), Abihu (he is my father), Eleazar (God has helped), and Ithamar (coast of palms).
Eleazar (God has helped) was the father of Phinehas (mouth of brass), Phinehas was the father of Abishua (my father is safety),
Abishua (my father is safety) was the father of Bukki (wasting), Bukki was the father of Uzzi (strong),
Uzzi (strong) was the father of Zerahiah (YHWH has risen), Zerahiah was the father of Meraioth (rebellious),
Meraioth (rebellious) was the father of Amariah (YHWH has promised), Amariah was the father of Ahitub (my brother is goodness),
Ahitub (my brother is goodness) was the father of Zadok (righteous), Zadok was the father of Ahimaaz (my brother is wrath),
Ahimaaz (my brother is wrath) was the father of Azariah (YHWH has helped), Azariah was the father of Johanan (YHWH has graced),
Johanan (YHWH has graced) was the father of Azariah (YHWH has helped), who served as priest in the temple that Solomon (peace) built in Jerusalem (city of peace),
Azariah (YHWH has helped) was the father of Amariah (YHWH has promised), Amariah was the father of Ahitub (my brother is goodness),
Ahitub (my brother is goodness) was the father of Zadok (righteous), Zadok was the father of Shallum (retribution),
Shallum (retribution) was the father of Hilkiah, Hilkiah (my portion is YHWH) was the father of Azariah (YHWH has helped),
Azariah (YHWH has helped) was the father of Seraiah (YHWH is ruler), and Seraiah was the father of Jehozadak (Jozadak).
Jehozadak (YHWH is righteous) went into captivity when the LORD {YHWH} sent Judah (praised) and Jerusalem (city of peace) into exile by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar (may Nebo protect the crown).
The sons of Levi (joined to): Gershom (Gershon), Kohath (assembly), and Merari (bitter).
These are the names of the sons of Gershom (foreigner): Libni (white) and Shimei (renowned).
The sons of Kohath (assembly): Amram (exalted people), Izhar (shining oil), Hebron (association), and Uzziel (my strength is God).
The sons of Merari (bitter): Mahli (sick) and Mushi (yielding). These are the clans of the Levites listed according to their fathers:
Of Gershom (foreigner): Libni (white) his son, Jahath (He will snatch up) his son, Zimmah (plotter) his son,
Joah (YHWH is brother) his son, Iddo (His witness) his son, Zerah (rising) his son, and Jeatherai (whom YHWH leads) his son.
The descendants of Kohath (assembly): Amminadab (my kinsman is noble) his son, Korah (bald) his son, Assir (prisoner) his son,
Elkanah (God has possessed) his son, Ebiasaph (Abiasaph) his son, Assir (prisoner) his son,
Tahath (station) his son, Uriel (God is my light) his son, Uzziah (my strength is YHWH) his son, and Shaul (desired) his son.
The descendants of Elkanah (God has possessed): Amasai (burdensome), Ahimoth (brother of death),
Elkanah (God has possessed) his son [Elkanah. The sons of Elkanah:], Zophai (honeycomb) his son, Nahath (rest) his son,
Eliab (Eliel) his son, Jeroham (showing pity) his son, and Elkanah (God has possessed) his son [and Samuel his son].
The sons of Samuel (his name is El): Joel his firstborn and Abijah (YHWH is my father) his second son.
The descendants of Merari (bitter): Mahli (sick), Libni (white) his son, Shimei (renowned) his son, Uzzah (strength) his son,
Shimea (fame) his son, Haggiah (festival of YHWH) his son, and Asaiah (made by YHWH) his son.
These are the men David (beloved) put in charge of the music in the house of the LORD {YHWH} after the ark rested there.

They ministered with song before the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting, until Solomon (peace) built the house of the LORD {YHWH} in Jerusalem (city of peace). And they performed their duties according to the regulations given them.
These are the men who served, together with their sons. From the Kohathites: Heman (faithful) the singer, the son of Joel (YHWH is God), the son of Samuel (his name is El),
the son of Elkanah (God has possessed), the son of Jeroham (showing pity), the son of Eliel (Eliab), the son of Toah (lowly),
the son of Zuph (honeycomb), the son of Elkanah (God has possessed), the son of Mahath (grasping), the son of Amasai (burdensome),
the son of Elkanah (God has possessed), the son of Joel (YHWH is God), the son of Azariah (YHWH has helped), the son of Zephaniah (YHWH has treasured),
the son of Tahath (station), the son of Assir (prisoner), the son of Ebiasaph (my father has gathered), the son of Korah (bald),
the son of Izhar (shining oil), the son of Kohath (assembly), the son of Levi (joined to), the son of Israel (he wrestles with God).
Heman’s kinsman was Asaph (gatherer), who served at his right hand: Asaph the son of Berechiah (YHWH blesses), the son of Shimea (fame),
the son of Michael (who is like God), the son of Baaseiah [Maaseiah], the son of Malchijah (my king is YHWH),
the son of Ethni (my hire), the son of Zerah (rising), the son of Adaiah (YHWH has adorned Himself),
the son of Ethan (enduring), the son of Zimmah (plotter), the son of Shimei (renowned),
the son of Jahath (He will snatch up), the son of Gershom (foreigner), the son of Levi (joined to).
On the left were their kinsmen, the sons of Merari (bitter): Ethan (enduring) the son of Kishi (bow of YHWH), the son of Abdi (servant of YHWH), the son of Malluch (counselor),
the son of Hashabiah (YHWH has considered), the son of Amaziah (YHWH is mighty), the son of Hilkiah (my portion is YHWH),
the son of Amzi (my strength), the son of Bani (built), the son of Shemer (preserved),
the son of Mahli (sick), the son of Mushi (yielding), the son of Merari (bitter), the son of Levi (joined to).
Their fellow Levites were assigned to every kind of service of the tabernacle, the house of God {Elohim}.

But Aaron (light bringer) and his sons did all the work of the Most Holy Place (the Holy of Holies). They presented the offerings on the altar of burnt offering and on the altar of incense to make atonement for Israel (he wrestles with God), according to all that Moses (drawn out) the servant of God {Elohim} had commanded.
These were the descendants of Aaron (light bringer): Eleazar (God has helped) his son, Phinehas (mouth of brass) his son, Abishua (my father is safety) his son,
Bukki (wasting) his son, Uzzi (strong) his son, Zerahiah (YHWH has risen) his son,
Meraioth (rebellious) his son, Amariah (YHWH has promised) his son, Ahitub (my brother is goodness) his son,
Zadok (righteous) his son, and Ahimaaz (my brother is wrath) his son.
Now these were the territories assigned to the descendants of Aaron (light bringer) from the Kohathite clan for their settlements, because the first lot fell to them:
They were given Hebron (association) in the land of Judah (praised) and its surrounding pasturelands.
But the fields and villages around the city were given to Caleb (dog) son of Jephunneh (He will be facing).
So the descendants of Aaron (light bringer) were given Hebron (association) (a city of refuge), Libnah (pavement) <Jos 21:13>, Jattir (plenty), Eshtemoa (fire of astonishment),
Hilen (place of caves) [Hilez], Debir (sanctuary),
Ashan (Ain), Juttah, and Beth-shemesh (house of the sun), together with their pasturelands.

And from the tribe of Benjamin (son of the right hand) they were given Gibeon, Geba (hill), Alemeth (covering), and Anathoth (answers to prayer), together with their pasturelands. So they had thirteen cities in all among their families.
To the rest of the Kohathites (assembly), ten cities were allotted from the half-tribe of Manasseh (causing to forget).

The Gershomites (Gershonites) (foreigner), according to their clans, were allotted thirteen cities from the tribes of Issachar (there is recompense), Asher (happy), Naphtali (wrestling), and Manasseh (causing to forget) in Bashan (fruitful).
The Merarites (bitter), according to their clans, were allotted twelve cities from the tribes of Reuben (behold a son), Gad (troop), and Zebulun (exalted).
So the Israelites (God prevails) gave to the Levites these cities and their pasturelands.
They assigned by lot the cities named above from the tribes of Judah (praised), Simeon (heard), and Benjamin (son of the right hand).
And some of the clans of the Kohathites (assembly) were given cities from the tribe of Ephraim (doubly fruitful) for their territory:
They were given Shechem (shoulder) (a city of refuge <Jos 21:21>) with its pasturelands in the hill country of Ephraim (doubly fruitful), and Gezer (portion),
Jokmeam (gathered by the people), Beth-horon (house of hollowness),
Aijalon (field of deer), and Gath-rimmon (winepress of the pomegranate), together with their pasturelands.
And from the half-tribe of Manasseh (causing to forget) the rest of the clans of the Kohathites (assembly) were given Aner (boy) and Bileam (not of the people), together with their pasturelands.

The Gershomites received the following (foreigner): From the clan of the half-tribe of Manasseh (causing to forget) they were given Golan (their captivity) in Bashan (fruitful) and also Ashtaroth (star), together with their pasturelands.
From the tribe of Issachar (there is recompense) they were given Kedesh (holy place), Daberath (word),
Ramoth (heights), and Anem (fountains), together with their pasturelands.
From the tribe of Asher (happy) they were given Mashal (entreaty), Abdon (servile),
Hukok (appointed), and Rehob (broad place), together with their pasturelands.
And from the tribe of Naphtali (wrestling) they were given Kedesh (holy place) in Galilee (circuit), Hammon (warm springs), and Kiriathaim (two cities), together with their pasturelands.

The Merarites (bitter) (the rest of the Levites) received the following: From the tribe of Zebulun (exalted) they were given [Jokneam, Kartah,] Rimmono (pomegranate) and Tabor, together with their pasturelands.
From the tribe of Reuben (behold a son) east of the Jordan (flowing down) opposite Jericho (city of palms) they were given Bezer (gold ore) in the wilderness, Jahzah (trodden down) (Jahaz),
Kedemoth (eastern), and Mephaath (splendor / height), together with their pasturelands.
And from the tribe of Gad (troop) they were given Ramoth (heights) in Gilead (rocky region), Mahanaim (two camps),
Heshbon (stronghold), and Jazer (helped), together with their pasturelands.
